answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 5311 Country: Pakistan Title: PLEASE TELL ME ABOUT LEASING?OR DOING JOB IN LEASING COMPANY ACCORDING TO ISLAMIC RULES OR NOT? Question: ASSALM O ALIKUM SIR PLEASE TELL ME ABOUT LEASING?OR DOING JOB IN LEASING COMPANY ACCORDING TO ISLAMIC RULES OR NOT. OK THANKS ALLAH HAFIZ Answer ID: 5311 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 804/695=B) If the company enters into halal contracts then it is allowed to work in the company provided there is no bribe. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
